What is Scored?

Your smart partner for running an institute

Scored is a web platform that brings institute administration and computer-based exams together. Attendance, payroll, admissions, CBT exams and analysis share one student record, so your team stops copying data between spreadsheets.

  • One login for office staff, teachers, the principal and parents
  • Your spreadsheet data migrated for you
  • Works on lab PCs, laptops and phones

Frequently Asked Questions

Can't find your answer? Email hello@scored.in.

What is Scored? How is it different from other institute software?

Scored is a AI-enabled institute management system and a CBT exam tool in one platform. Most institutes use separate tools for the office and for exams. In Scored, attendance, payroll, admissions, exam marks and analysis share one student record, so nothing is typed twice.

Who is Scored built for?

CBSE, ICSE, State Board, Matriculation, Cambridge and IB institutes from pre-primary to Class 12, as well as coaching centres and multi-branch institute groups.

How much does Scored cost?

Plans are priced per student per year, and every plan includes setup, data migration, training and support. Essentials covers AI-enabled institute management, Complete adds CBT exams and analysis, and Group adds multi-branch tools. Book a demo for a quote based on your student count, or see our plans.

How are CBT exams kept secure?

Questions and options are shuffled for every student, tests are timed, and secure exam mode keeps the test full-screen and records every time a student leaves the test window. Role-based access means each user sees only what their role allows.

Can you move our existing data from Excel?

Yes. We import your student, staff, payroll and fee spreadsheets and check them with your office team before go-live.

Can parents see attendance and marks?

Yes. Parents log in from any phone to see attendance, fee dues, CBT exam results and report cards.
